messages:
maria: deploy-bot flagged publish for redwood/runtime-api:v2026-03-20-rc3 — cosign attestation missing build-id, blocking staging mirror. logs below.

deploy-bot: [system] publish blocked: provenance_verification_failed; expected build_id=sha256:abcd1234... actual=absent. Action: HOLD.

sam: ugh. which step dropped the attestation? CI sign step succeeded on ci-123 but we see no attestation in ECR metadata.

kevin: I can re-run cosign step quickly. But wondering if image digest changed due to build caching. Can we pin by digest instead of retag?

maria: good point. current digest from registry: sha256:0f1e2d3c4b5e6f7a8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8a9b0c1d2e3f4g5h6i7j8k9l0 (truncated); CI reported digest sha256:0f1e2d3c4..., so digest matches, attestation missing. suspect cosign auth to KMS expired at 03:14 UTC.

olivia: if we re-sign, we need to avoid invalidating downstream mirrors. We should retag a new "signed" tag instead of overwriting rc3.

sam: plan: 1) re-run cosign signer with backup KMS creds (kevin), 2) push attestation to ECR, 3) notify deploy-bot to unhold. If can't sign in <30m then fallback: pin runtime-api in deploy manifest to sha256:0f1e2d3c4... and proceed with canary.

kevin: I'm on it. spinning up signer. ping me if deploy window closes.

deploy-bot: [system] hold placed by policy: provenance_missing. Manual override allowed by role=release-manager.

release-manager: I'll be available to manual-approve if re-sign hangs. @kevin please post cosign output.

kevin: cosign verify output (partial):
```
$ cosign verify --key kms://projects/rdw/keyring/ci-signer redwood/runtime-api@sha256:0f1e2d3c4...
error: no signatures found: manifest has no attestations
```

kevin: Re-signer run started: `cosign sign --attached --key kms://projects/rdw/keyring/ci-signer redwood/runtime-api@sha256:0f1e2d3c4...` => OK, now pushing attestation.

kevin: pushed attestation to ecr://eu-west-1/redwood/runtime-api@sha256:0f1e2d3c4...

deploy-bot: [system] attestation detected; provenance_verified. releasing hold.

maria: canary deploy started. will watch metrics and error traces. tagging policy: we will not overwrite v2026-03-20-rc3; new tag v2026-03-20-rc3-signed created.

olivia: add a note to release notes and to the postmortem for the signer KMS TTL. Also schedule a short-change window next week to rotate creds.

sam: thanks all :thumbsup:
